name: Temptation of Glory

source.title: Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea

disable: DC 25 Arcana check or DC 25 Religion check (expert) to disrupt the images; DC 26 Occultism check (expert) to shout a countering chant; DC 27 Intimidation check (expert) to scare the images away; DC 28 Will save save (expert) to refuse to listen
routine:
(1 per PC) The hazard targets a PC and uses cruel temptation

---
Special The hazard continues each round until defeated, and the hallway's end cannot be reached until the hazard is stopped.

items.name: Tempt
items.text:
Trigger A PC moves down the exit hallway

---
Effect The ghostly images turn cruel and hungry, grasping and slashing at the PC

text: Ghostly images of your heart's desire appear and beckon you toward them.
